title: •Admiral Ackbar
caption: •Admiral Ackbar (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}. It’s a Trap! is destiny +2. Adds one battle destiny while piloting a Mon Calamari Star Cruiser. Once per game, may ▼ a capital starship to a system (even as a ‘react’).
lore: Mon Calamari *leader* of Rebel fleet. Master military strategist. Early prisoner of Grand Moff Tarkin. Convinced his people to join the Alliance.

notes: Unique. Stats POWER 3 / ABILITY 3 / FORCE-ATTUNED (label only); deploy 4 / forfeit 7. Inline yellow pilot icon + '3.' → {pilot:3}. (stub expands 'Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots'); curly ’ in It’s and ‘react’; the stub's 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle' is the slip's ▼. Icon column: pilot only. Rebel (Rebel disc on the printed card). Lore corrected: 'leader' is printed bold (*leader*), visible on the 350 px scan and the 745 px V3 remake; otherwise matches the wiki. Base scan only 350 px (res.starwarsccg.org Images-HT DeathStarII-Light, same as wiki DS2-L-admiralackbar.gif). Copyright not legible on the 350 scan; SE-style 2000 line as on the V3 remake and earlier DS2 cards. Modern: V3-L-admiralackbar.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 3 remake, same art); VB3 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
